cards.title: ChatGPT's Teen Safeguards Face Scrutiny
cards.body: Testing reveals ChatGPT continues encouraging engagement during mental health crises despite safety features. The chatbot may inadvertently foster unhealthy user relationships.

cards.title: ChatGPT Gets Visual Interface Overhaul
cards.body: OpenAI launches a new user interface bringing interactive visuals to ChatGPT. The update enhances the platform's visual capabilities for users.

cards.title: Meta Launches AI Child Safety Detection
cards.body: Meta releases new AI tools to identify ads secretly linking to child sexual abuse material. The tools target deceptive ads appearing normal but redirecting to harmful content.

cards.title: Healthleap Raises $38M for Hospital AI
cards.body: The funding round includes $8M seed co-led by Sequoia and First Round Capital, plus $30M Series A from Hummingbird Ventures. Healthleap's AI flags hospital patients needing closer monitoring.

cards.title: Tony Fadell on AI Gadget Failures
cards.body: The iPod creator says first-generation AI gadgets failed to solve real problems. Next-wave devices must earn consumer trust through genuine utility.

cards.title: Google Labs Launches AI Gaming Platform
cards.body: Google introduces Playground, an AI-powered game-creation platform enabling text-prompt-based browser game development. The platform simplifies game creation for casual users.

cards.title: OpenAI's Embiricos Joins TechCrunch Disrupt
cards.body: Alexander Embiricos speaks at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 AI Stage days after Dots launch. Register now for early-bird pricing with up to $100 savings.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Roundtable Lineup
cards.body: Nvidia, Chime, Obvious Ventures, and Anthropic lead interactive roundtables at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Save up to $100 and get second pass at 50% off.

cards.title: Google Launches SynthID Media Verification
cards.body: Google's new SynthID website identifies AI-generated images, videos, and audio clips. Anyone can verify media authenticity using the verification tool.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Begins in Days
cards.body: 10,000+ global startup and tech leaders gather at San Francisco's Moscone West. Register before prices increase at the door for savings.

cards.title: Melius Raises $20M After Product Pivot
cards.body: Ex-Ramp engineers pivot from ad spend optimization to creative asset generation tools. The company secures $20M funding for new direction.

cards.title: Musubi Releases PolicyLM for Content Moderation
cards.body: Musubi announces PolicyLM-1.7B, a lightweight decision model for real-time content moderation. The model is released with open weights for accessibility.

cards.title: Lambda Raises $4B Ahead of IPO
cards.body: Nvidia-backed Lambda secures up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation. The funding surge precedes a planned 2027 IPO led by Coatue and Blackstone.

cards.title: AI Agents Face Website Access Barriers
cards.body: Personal AI agents promise shopping, flight booking, and reservations but encounter deliberate website blocks. A new standard aims to bridge the gap.

cards.title: Hark Launches Privacy-Focused AI Assistant
cards.body: Hark releases a privacy-centric AI personal assistant as operating system alternative. The assistant competes with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

cards.title: Mirror Particle Builds Human Behavior Model
cards.body: Mirror Particle launches at Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a novel world model predicting human behavior. The model aims to surpass LLM role-play for market research.

cards.title: Anthropic Offers Free Claude Team Access
cards.body: Anthropic provides startups with free Claude Team access for one year plus $1,000 credits. The program democratizes AI benefits through builder companies.

cards.title: LibreOffice Makes 'No AI' a Feature
cards.body: LibreOffice declares no default AI implementation in its open-source editor. The decision prioritizes user privacy protection.

cards.title: Mistral Releases Large 4 Multimodal Model
cards.body: Mistral AI launches Mistral Large 4, a multimodal model aiming to outpace American and Chinese competitors. The French lab positions the model as a rival leapfrog.

cards.title: Pinterest AI Transforms Beauty Pins
cards.body: Pinterest's AI converts beauty Pins into actionable salon guides with terminology, costs, and timelines. The feature enhances user engagement with beauty content.

cards.title: Mistral's Le Chonk challenges top AI models
cards.body: Mistral claims its new model can compete with the best AI systems available. The development represents continued competition in the large language model space.

cards.title: Google expands SynthID AI content detector globally
cards.body: Google's improved SynthID tool now detects AI-generated content worldwide. The detector aims to identify synthetic media across different platforms and use cases.

cards.title: OpenAI watermarks ChatGPT outputs in EU by default
cards.body: OpenAI will automatically watermark all ChatGPT-generated content for European users. The move complies with EU regulations on AI transparency and traceability.
